question: Should the agent activity timeline ship as a first-class core CLI/chat/TUI/export surface now, and should it be built on the metadata-audit and subagent-lifecycle foundations first?
rationale: The source has partial live Activity and trajectory surfaces, but the durable event model, retention/redaction rules, authorization boundary, and UI/CLI placement need maintainer product and security intent before implementation.

options.title: Design on audit foundation first
options.body: Use the metadata-only audit ledger and lifecycle receipt work as the canonical source before adding timeline presentation and JSON export.

options.title: Ship ephemeral timeline only
options.body: Add a non-durable timeline view reusing current live events, accepting that JSON export and historical query remain out of scope.

options.title: Decline core timeline for now
options.body: Keep Activity and trajectory export as the supported surfaces and route richer timeline experiments to plugins until demand or API gaps are clearer.

recommendation.title: Design on audit foundation first
recommendation.body: Use the metadata-only audit ledger and lifecycle receipt work as the canonical source before adding timeline presentation and JSON export.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the related audit-foundation issue and appears in recent state/runtime history central to the persistence and security boundary.
